text.tspan: I stopped chasing perfect workouts and started
chasing finished ones.
I keep a gym bag by the door so friction
cannot win.
Protein at breakfast made afternoon cravings
less dramatic.
Discipline is mostly logistics.
Appreciate the people who made this easier.
Finished beats perfect most Tuesdays.
Walking meetings replaced two coffees that
were mostly sitting.
Small sessions keep the identity alive.
I measure progress by how stairs feel, not
only by the mirror.
Environment design beats willpower speeches.
I track sleep more carefully than I track PRs.
Show up for the boring weeks. That is where
fitness is built.

I write the next workout in the calendar
before I leave the current one.
